cases.assertion: Each token of suffix A matches a fresh uncached P||A[:i] next-logit vector.
Each token of distinct suffix B matches uncached P||B[:i]; not A||B.
Snapshot P next logits agree with fresh P before any suffix is added.
After each accepted generated/forced token, consumed length, positions and next logits align.
Prefill P in one batch or chunks, with identical fixed tokens, yields equivalent state.
Fork at page_len-1, page_len, page_len+1; both children match fresh oracle.
Same repeated token or last token in different histories cannot collide in prefix-cache identity.
Two histories sharing the same final KV block contents but different earlier tokens never incorrectly share states.
Positions and attention visibility match a fresh reference at long and offset prefixes.
RoPE/YaRN config changes are incompatible unless an explicitly proven converter exists.
Same displayed text with different exact tokenization/template identity cannot share incompatible history.
Causal/window/multimodal visibility metadata is included and validated.
Processing branches A and B in reverse/interleaved order cannot contaminate histories/logits.
Saving immediately after sample cannot produce sampled-but-unconsumed cache frontier.
Seven accepted tokens, save, twenty more, restore, repeat: tokens and draws agree.
Controller stores actual RNG draw cursor if sampler uses variable draws per token.
Mid-grammar restoration preserves legal-token state and never bypasses grammar.
Stop matcher and EOS status survive restore; stopped scope remains stopped.
Generate(7)+Generate(20) equals Generate(27) under same scope.
One branch consuming 100 extra RNG draws cannot affect sibling stream.
Different stream IDs may lead to identical tokens; API does not assert otherwise.
Backend refuses incomplete recurrent/convolution state save rather than claiming support.
Different weights/adapters/architecture cannot import old numerical checkpoints.
A numerically incompatible checkpoint representation is rejected or safely recomputed.
Independent oracle performs full-history forward with no SUT cache hits.
Logit comparison uses frozen tolerances and does not equate text similarity with correctness.
A resumable streamed token has a durable, fully consumed matching snapshot.
Persist prefix/branch, close process and reopen, then continue same exact history.
Delete every cached numeric state and reconstruct logits/tokens from retained inputs.
Flip checkpoint payload byte; detect checksum mismatch and refuse/rebuild.
Corrupt consumed count, model fingerprint or position map; reject/check compatibility.
Interrupt staged checkpoint write before rename; incomplete object is never discoverable.
Kill before snapshot publish; branch pointer remains on prior fully durable history.
Kill after staging refs+receipt before rename; old head remains intact.
Kill after refs rename before ack; retry same operation ID returns a single committed result.
Reusing operation ID with different parameters returns conflict, not silent success.
CAS with stale revision fails after P→A→P movement.
Independent workers contending on stale revision yield exactly one winner.
Fault after partial backend token ingest discards lease; no partially consumed public snapshot.
Backend allocation failure does not corrupt published history or other branches.
Cache eviction can never delete retained history; historical deletion requires distinct authorization.
Checkpoint from another model/positional profile cannot be silently loaded.
After cold restore controller state includes RNG, grammar, penalties and stop state.
Lost required multimodal/input artifact yields explicit failure, not fabricated replay.
Restoring saved conversation does not rerun external tools or irreversible side effects.
Fault evidence explicitly distinguishes process kill from power-loss durability.
Second hot fork shows zero duplicate full-prefix prefill work with internal counters.
Unique prefix pages do not grow k-fold as k branches fork the same root.
Fork at each partial-page position: sibling append copies/makes private tail only.
Byte/checksum audit proves shared pages remain immutable across child generation.
Shared quantizer metadata/outlier state cannot be mutated by sibling.
When applicable, recurrent state is isolated or capability blocked.
Eviction of one numerical state leaves siblings and root reconstructible.
If supported, exact persisted state offload and restore agree with fresh oracle.
Forced allocation pressure uses fallback or error without branch corruption.
Measured tail-copy work is bounded by page size, not the whole prefix.
Fork costs O(1) logical reference work; classify physical lease activation separately.
Many fork/release/rewind cycles return allocations to stable baseline.
Randomized concurrent branch updates, COW and cache eviction preserve the oracle.
Corrupt/offline cache page is never fed to attention; replay or explicit error.
Instrumented counters reflect actual backend work, not guessed from response time.
Capacity limits and scaling measured at short, medium and longest supported contexts.
P forks into three recorded alternative suffixes that each match fresh oracle.
Rewind one branch to P and take another suffix; old future stays reachable.
Evaluation cannot modify model history, controller, other candidates or refs.
Same evaluator code, fixture, seed and snapshot produce same declared score.
Evaluator uses sandboxed or mocked external effects and never reruns irreversible tools.
Validated winner adoption moves one branch pointer exactly once.
Racing stale winner adoption fails without rewriting any candidate.
Scores and evaluator source identity are immutable provenance records.
Selected branch survives all numerical eviction and matches fresh oracle.
Scoring a candidate does not perturb branch-local generation draws.
Nonwinning futures remain reproducibly accessible until explicit history GC.
Run every advertised supported model/backend/precision/profile combination; report unsupported.
At least 1000 reproducible action sequences compare SUT to independent model-free and real oracles.
Checkpoint migration refuses incompatible old layouts; retained inputs cold-replay under compatible model.
Long-duration release soak with memory/throughput/corruption stats and recorded hardware.
Run applicable ASan/UBSan/TSan or memory-safety tools and record unsupported tools.
Knowing a content hash does not bypass authorization to read/fork/evaluate.
Access permissions/at-rest policy for potentially sensitive cache and history checked.
Reachability-aware GC never deletes live heads or actively leased snapshots.
GC under concurrent materialize, fork, rewind and eval cannot create dangling state.
Ambiguous acknowledgements after process termination recovered by operation receipts.
All 12 specified failure mutants are detected by at least one independent test.
Rollback leaves authoritative history and branch revision identities valid.
